identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: The Beginning

leadText:
In , a 10-year old Ash Ketchum starts his to become a Pokémon Master, setting off from Pallet Town with his , . Traveling through the region of Kanto, he faces Gym Leaders to earn Badges and encounters challenges that test his skills, often clashing with the villainous Team Rocket trio and butting heads with his rival, Gary Oak. Accompanying Ash through his journey are , a tomboyish Trainer from Cerulean City, and , an aspiring from Pewter City.

After competing in the Indigo Plateau Conference, Ash is sent on an errand by , which sees him travel to the Orange Islands to retrieve the mysterious GS Ball from Professor Ivy. While Brock seems to find his true calling as Professor Ivy's , his place in is temporarily filled up by Tracey Sketchit, a Pokémon Watcher and an enthusiastic fan of Professor Oak. Ash's delivery mission gets delayed when he learns about the Orange League and decides to compete in it, giving him a set of new and unique Gyms to challenge.
